tools.name: GetActiveSystems
tools.description: Returns all active systems from the RDF database. Used to populate system directory lists on the System Network Map and Data Object Impact pages.
tools.title: Get Active Systems

system.description: The full URI of the system to analyze.
system.title: system

tools.name: GetDataFlowImpact
tools.description: Returns ADS status, creator/modifier data objects, and first-order outbound interface connections for a system.
tools.title: Get Data Flow Impact

tools.name: GetSystemNetwork
tools.description: Returns the data-flow-only system network (Systems, Interfaces, DataObjects) filtered to interfaces with Payload data. Used by the System Network Map.
tools.title: Get System Network

system.description: The full URI of the system to inspect, e.g. http://health.mil/ontologies/Concept/System/AHLTA
system.title: system

tools.name: GetSystemDetails
tools.description: Retrieves all attribute details for a single system: data objects, interfaces, environment, transactional status, business processes, activities, and user types.
tools.title: Get System Details
